confirmation.title: R18-CE-01 (same root as the capture owner's issue 1): Den of Woe soft-locks at link 2 when a girl carries Stop. O3's FFX-2 Stop freeze stops her tween clock, and the opening's party slide-in waits on it for ever
confirmation.note: CONFIRMED, with the cause checked in code and by test. The code at D:/pyrefly-rel26c (HEAD 65152c1b) matches the trace. statusLooks.ts:79 sets stop: { freeze: true } for FFX-2. In statusFigureTint.ts:206, the wrapper calls entry.update(this.frozen(id, entry) ? 0 : dt). frozen() at :219 is true for as long as look.freeze holds, heldFor<=0 and the figure is not in `acting`. In BattleMoments.ts:302-315, slidePartyIn awaits actor.moveTo(home, ms + i*70) for every party member, outside any action, so nothing sets acting or heldFor for the Stopped girl. I re-ran the reporter's headless test myself: vitest run with critic/rounds/round-18/combat/vitest.critic.config.ts, filter den-stop-seam, from D:/pyrefly-rel26c. It passed 1/1 and rewrote den-stop-seam.json at 14:58. Engine part: in both Wait and Active, the candidate engine carries Stop into Shade Gippal and advances (max ATB elapsed 3921 ms, Grinder on Yuna first). Mechanism part: the test uses the real TweenGroup and the real StatusFigureTint. The stopped Yuna's slide had still not finished after 60 s of frames, while Rikku's finished at 0.53 s. After setActing(['yuna']), Yuna's slide finished as well. My independent real-key run (see the first title) shows the same stall on a different path. introducedByCandidate=true: statusFigureTint.ts is O3 code that is new in this candidate. regressionVsLive=true: the reporter's live-31a run passes the same seam state (Yuna's ATB state 'stop'), and I did not re-run live myself, so this part is reused, not re-proven. The proposed smallest fix is sound: freeze only the idle/life clock, not the one-shot TweenGroup, or treat the party as acting during slidePartyIn or any moment:* phase. It keeps the sourced look.
